تمضمضت (form IIq)
# تَمَضْمَضْتُ (tamaḍmaḍtu) /ta.madˤ.madˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَمَضْمَضَ (tamaḍmaḍa)
# تَمَضْمَضْتَ (tamaḍmaḍta) /ta.madˤ.madˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَمَضْمَضَ (tamaḍmaḍa)
# تَمَضْمَضْتِ (tamaḍmaḍti) /ta.madˤ.madˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَمَضْمَضَ (tamaḍmaḍa)
# تَمَضْمَضَتْ (tamaḍmaḍat) /ta.madˤ.ma.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
